verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud docs explicitly claim automatic scale-to-zero when idle, separate scaling of compute/storage, and the ability to 'set compute autoscaling limits' and 'start building instantly without having to size and scale your cluster,' which directly supports auto up/down scaling without manual resizing. However this applies only to the Cloud offering (not self-hosted OSS, where community reports note scaling and ops burden are manual/harder), and there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming seamless scale-up under load or a no-downtime guarantee during scale events. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scale-up behavior under load, explicit no-downtime guarantee documentation, and clarity that this applies beyond the managed Cloud product.
